summary: This Form 8-K reports unregistered sales of Class I common stock and provides an update on a continuous public offering by Blue Owl Credit Income Corp., a BDC. On April 1, 2026, 349,381 Class I shares were sold for $3.18M in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S. The company has an ongoing public offering of up to $14.0B across share classes, selling at NAV per share plus sales load. This is routine capital raising activity, not a special situation. No external action, transaction, or corporate event is disclosed.
